title: Investigation of novel ligand targeting bromodomain-containing protein 4 (BRD4) for cancer drug discovery: complete pharmacophore approach.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过药效团虚拟筛选、分子对接和MD模拟研究BRD4小分子抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作建模，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: The Bromodomain (BRD4) and extra-terminal (BET) protein family are reversible; lysine-acetylated epigenetic readers identified as key important epigenetic regulators for protein recognition in posttranslational modifications for targeting cancer for its role in super-enhancers and transcription of oncogene expression in cancer and other forms of cancer and various diseases. Firstly, JQ-1a small potent BET inhibitors, targeting BET proteins were currently in clinical trials to ablate cancer. The identified compounds were taken from the library of preexisting therapeutically potent molecules. The objective of the present study is to identify the potential small molecule inhibitors against BRD4 through in-silico approach for the treatment of cancer. In present study, designed an in-silico screening of small molecules through ligand-based pharmacophore studies against bromodomain-containing protein 4 (BRD-4) protein and used for virtual screening through Database and their binding affinity and interaction of identified molecules were predicted through molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations for 12 fixed time period, Molecular mechanics (MMGBSA) binding free energy calculations, ADME with drug-likeness properties including violations of lipinski's rule of 5, Jorgensens rule of 3 and other parameters were studied. The docking results indicate from the reported database screened molecules were validated with docking score -7.92 to -4.27Kcal/mol for BRD4-BD1 and the best model identified 21 hits. Among these two drugs were filtered and scrutinized for their ability based on binding modes and common interaction, MMGBSA of the highest affinity -54.53 Kcal/mol of BRD4-BD1 and ADME properties of selected molecules were predicted for its various parameters, dynamics studies evaluating its binding stability using Maestro software. In Conclusion, two BRD4 inhibitors were found to bind strongly in the similar binding sites as JQ-1, highlighting the role of BRD4-BD1. These compounds were identified as promising new options for regulating epigenetics and understanding the structural needs of BRD4 protein, further research in these areas could lead to the development of more effective and targeted cancer drugs.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 溴结构域蛋白4（BRD4）和末端外（BET）蛋白家族是可逆的；赖氨酸乙酰化表观遗传阅读器，被确定为蛋白质识别中翻译后修饰的关键表观遗传调控因子，因其在超级增强子中的作用及癌症及其他类型癌症和多种疾病中癌基因表达的转录而成为癌症靶向治疗的重要靶点。首先，JQ-1是一种小分子强效BET抑制剂，靶向BET蛋白，目前正在进行临床试验以消除癌症。所识别的化合物取自先前具有治疗潜力的分子库。本研究旨在通过计算机模拟方法识别针对BRD4的潜在小分子抑制剂，用于癌症治疗。在本研究中，设计了一种基于配体的药效团研究，对含溴结构域蛋白4（BRD-4）进行小分子计算机模拟筛选，并通过数据库进行虚拟筛选，通过分子对接、12个固定时间段的分子动力学模拟、分子力学（MMGBSA）结合自由能计算、ADME及药物相似性（包括Lipinski五规则、Jorgensen三规则及其他参数的违反情况）预测了所识别分子的结合亲和力和相互作用。对接结果表明，从报告数据库中筛选的分子对BRD4-BD1的对接分数在-7.92至-4.27 Kcal/mol之间，最佳模型识别出21个命中化合物。其中，两种药物根据结合模式和常见相互作用被筛选和审查，BRD4-BD1的最高亲和力MMGBSA为-54.53 Kcal/mol，所选分子的ADME特性预测了其各项参数，并使用Maestro软件评估了其结合稳定性的动力学研究。总之，发现两种BRD4抑制剂与JQ-1在相似结合位点强烈结合，突显了BRD4-BD1的作用。这些化合物被确定为调控表观遗传学和理解BRD4蛋白结构需求的新有前景选项，进一步研究这些领域可能有助于开发更有效和靶向的癌症药物。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
